## Appearance

Harris is described as a very dashing young person. He features a huge, drooping pompadour, big, rolling brown eyes, and an extensive, bewildering smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_

## History

Harris is a clerk at a shop in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). He serves [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) when [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) awkwardly attempts to purchase dress goods for [Anne](../character/anne.md). Due to Matthew's shyness and inability to ask for fabric from a female clerk, Harris ends up selling him twenty yards of brown dress goods and a garden rake instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
